# EXP-NNN: Exploration Title

> Replace every placeholder. This artifact may investigate and compare; it
> does not make an architectural decision or authorize production work.

## Questions / Hypotheses

- Question to answer or hypothesis to test.

## Scope

Define the investigation boundary and explicit non-goals.

## Known Constraints

- Established product, architecture, platform, resource, or evidence boundary.

## Candidate Directions

Describe credible candidates neutrally. Candidates are not decisions.

## Evidence Plan

- Research, measurement, review, or linked Spike needed.

## Findings

Record evidence with provenance and distinguish observation from inference.

## Remaining Unknowns

- Unknown and what would resolve it.

## Disposition

Choose and explain one when pausing or concluding: continue, pause, abandon,
close without action, promote to Proposal, or feed an existing accepted
Proposal/RFC. A recommendation is not approval.

## Revisit Triggers

- Concrete event, threshold, dependency, or new evidence.

## References

- Source artifacts, Spikes, measurements, code, or external evidence.
